_comment: XBRL tag mapping for the Automated Equity Research Desk pipeline.
_doc: Each canonical line item maps to a priority-ordered list of us-gaap XBRL tags. The normalizer tries tags in order and stops at the first one that returns a value. If none match, the field is flagged MISSING_TAG.

revenue._notes: Broadest revenue concept available (interest + fee income). Standard tag is Revenues; fallbacks handle contract fee tags and specialized net interest/fee income concepts.

net_income._notes: Standard tag. Prefer NetIncomeLoss (includes minority interest); fall back to NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic if needed.

total_assets._notes: Standard balance sheet tag. Present for all filers.

shareholders_equity._notes: Prefer total equity. Some filers use StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest when there are minority interests.

current_assets._notes: Consumer lenders often lack a clear current/non-current split on the balance sheet. Flag MISSING_TAG if absent.

current_liabilities._notes: Same issue as current_assets — may be absent for bank/lending filers.

receivables._notes: This is the core earning asset for consumer lenders. Tags vary significantly: AFRM uses NotesReceivableNet for held-for-investment loans; OMF uses LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmount. We cascade through all reasonable tags.

operating_cash_flow._notes: Standard cash flow statement tag. Critical for accruals ratio calculation.

interest_expense._notes: Needed for interest coverage ratio. May include funding cost on securitization facilities.

gross_profit._notes: INTENTIONALLY may be absent for consumer lenders — no COGS concept. If missing, flag MISSING_TAG. Do NOT attempt to synthesize. The ratio engine will handle absent gross profit gracefully.

retained_earnings._notes: Needed for Altman Z-Score (RE/TA component). Most filers report this; accumulated deficit is negative.

total_debt._notes: Aggregate borrowings. Consumer lenders often have complex funding stacks (warehouse lines, ABS notes, corporate debt). LongTermDebt is the closest standard tag; fallbacks handle warehouse/credit facilities and compound debt stacks.

ebit._notes: Needed for Altman Z-Score (EBIT/TA). No direct tag — computed in ratio engine as NetIncomeLoss + IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit + InterestExpense. Stored as COMPUTED in source_tag.

income_tax_expense._notes: Used to compute EBIT when OperatingIncomeLoss is absent.

working_capital._notes: Computed as current_assets - current_liabilities in the ratio engine. Not pulled directly from EDGAR.
